narratives.Overview:
## Parent

Epic **#55** ΓÇö native agent slash-command registration (multi-host).

## Summary

Wire **init/update** (or deposit path) to register native commands for the **configured multi-host set** ΓÇö idempotent, opt-out capable, no last-writer-wins single host.

## Depends on

- B (core) + C (emitters) for something to deposit
- Align with existing `hostHooks` / deposit mental model (#2438 lineage)

## Scope

- Project (or user) policy for **enabled host set** (default leans multi-host for known hosts; per-host opt-out)
- `directive init` / `update` (or shared deposit helper) writes all enabled hosts in one pass
- Idempotent re-run; no duplicate pile-up
- Interaction with gitignore vs commit left to docs child unless a deposit default must choose

## Out of scope

- Inventing slash names (A)
- Prose-only fallback removal (must keep)

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Multi-host enabled set deposits all corresponding native files on init/update
- [ ] Single-host-only is not the product default
- [ ] Per-host opt-out works without breaking other hosts
- [ ] Re-run is idempotent
- [ ] Hooks deposit model remains coherent (slash registration parallel, not conflicting)

## Refs

- Parent: #55
- Related: #2438 (hooks deposit pattern)
narratives.UserStory: As a multi-host Directive operator, I want init and update to deposit slash command files for enabled hosts, so that native autocomplete works without hand-copying wrappers.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Call #3053 emitter APIs during init/update deposit paths.
- Policy for enabled hosts + per-host opt-out (L6).
- Prefer commit of generated dirs (L8); idempotent rewrite.
- Tests for deposit paths and opt-out.
- CHANGELOG #3054 Refs #55.
- Out of scope: docs dogfood (#3055); expanding L2 set.

narrative.Acceptance: Given enabled hosts in policy, when init or update runs, then thin command files are written under each host layout from #3053 emitters.
Given a host opted out, when deposit runs, then that host directory is not written or is left untouched per policy.
Given a second update, when deposit re-runs, then files update without duplication and stay thin wrappers only.
Given deposit unit tests and CHANGELOG, when reviewed, then opt-out and multi-host deposit are covered and #3054 is cited.
